column1: # The fleet: every repository a release tags, the branch the tag goes on
# (that repo's publish branch), and the images its publish workflow pushes
# for a v<version> tag. {v} is the version without its v. One tab-free line
# per repository; fields are separated by runs of spaces.
# scripts/release.sh reads this to tag the fleet; scripts/release-stack.py
# reads it to check that every pipestreamai/* image in the compose stack
# has a publisher, and to verify the published tags before the GitHub
# Several GitHub repos default to a stale Renovate-only `development`
# branch; the branch column, not GitHub's default, is where the tag goes.
gRParse             main         grparse:{v} grparse:{v}-cpu grparse:{v}-openvino grparse-models:{v} grparse-demo-shell:{v}
